# Pinned JSON Schema format vectors

Unmodified test data from [JSON-Schema-Test-Suite](https://github.com/json-schema-org/JSON-Schema-Test-Suite/tree/245a45abc90190c0bff04d97e6d2b541b4bb9f12), commit `245a45abc90190c0bff04d97e6d2b541b4bb9f12`.
The MIT license is retained in `LICENSE`; exact source URLs and SHA-256 values are in `identity.json`.

These nine format files are targeted inputs for the native final-value checker.
They add no production dependency. Passing these vectors is not proof that the
schema generation adapter or HTTP integration has been completed.
